rules: References are unapproved illustrations, never proof of TalkBack or text-size runtime behaviour
Record Android build SHA, device/API, density, viewport, fontScale and accessibility settings
Each interaction logs photo ID before and after, accessibility focus, target bounds px→dp, outcome state
Dedicated reduced-motion and focus-route diagrams exist; neither is native behavioural evidence

cases.title: Reel target dimensions
cases.required: Measure bounds in dp; demonstrate tapping, Previous/Next, Grid stable ID

cases.title: Home text at 200%
cases.required: Native fontScale=2.0 captures with insets and clipped-line detection

cases.title: Reel 200% count
cases.required: Selected item index/total and alternatives available at scale

cases.title: Import progress 200%
cases.required: Pending vs disabled actions visible and announced

cases.title: High contrast
cases.required: Contrast/focus/checked icon tested beyond static SVG

cases.title: Motion-independent equivalent
cases.required: Dedicated draft before/after Next reference exists; require real zero-spin native p12→p13 selection and focus evidence

cases.title: TalkBack sequence
cases.required: Dedicated focus-order draft overlay exists; verify actual Android spoken output, focus restoration and 22-item index/total

cases.title: Narrow/short viewport recovery
cases.required: Inset and keyboard bounds, access to retry and back
